title: Lakshmi Textiles v. Labour Welfare Board

brief.about: The appeal challenges a demand of Rs. 9,30,000 towards welfare cess for 2019-22 computed on the full wage bill including contract labour. Issue notice.
brief.last: Reply is filed. The appellant is directed to file the contractor-wise wage registers.

orders.summary: The appeal challenges a demand of Rs. 9,30,000 towards welfare cess for 2019-22 computed on the full wage bill including contract labour. Issue notice.
directions: Recovery is stayed subject to deposit of half the demand.
